main.station_number: skip: station identifier (the ministry's licence number); used only as a sort tie-break, searchable in the explorer
main.station_name: skip: station name, free text; read only to keep rows with an empty authority, searchable in the explorer
main.company: chart-co, chart-tier, chart-auth, chart-locco, chart-ind, kpi:chains, kpi:ind, insight:leader, insight:chains, insight:road, insight:ind — spelling variants normalised
main.location: chart-loc, chart-locco, insight:road — free-text location classified by keyword into location types
main.City: insight:city — the locality when it differs from the authority (regional councils); filled for about 45% of rows
main.authority_name: chart-auth, chart-dist, chart-ind, kpi:auth, insight:cities, insight:single, insight:ind, insight:city
main.telephone: skip: contact numbers, some of them private mobiles; not put on the page (visible in the explorer)
